index.title: Design Your Home
index.tagline: Build a house by shape, roof, floors and color — then download a PDF with views from every side. It's not a game, there are no points.
allsides: Views from all sides + roof (included in the PDF):
future: Next phases (per the brief): detailed room layouts (rectangular/square, where the window/sink/toilet go), scrollable gallery, uploading your own pictures, and a top-1000 ranking with likes.
gallery.title: Design Your Home — Gallery
gallery.tagline: Browse houses from others. Like the ones you enjoy — likes only, no comments.
gallery.needlogin: To like and submit, sign in. Browsing is free.
gallery.empty: No approved houses yet. Be the first — open the Builder.
ranking.title: Design Your Home — Ranking
ranking.tagline: Top houses by number of likes. The most original rise to the top.
login.title: Design Your Home — Sign in
login.tagline: Sign in or register to save houses to the gallery, like and submit.

local.title: Design Your Home — My projects
local.tagline: Everything you design is stored on this device — no account and no connection needed. An account is only for publishing to the gallery.

err.offline: No connection to the server. Local mode still works: everything is kept on this device.
